pages.text: Workhand Pickaxes upgrade the standard pickaxe with area mining capabilities. Each material tier (Stone, Iron, Diamond) offers 4 grades of tools with increasing mining areas.

pages.title: Grade Progression
pages.text:
$(bold)Grade 1$(): 3x3x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Grade 2$(): 3x3x3 cubic OR 3x3x1 flat (right-click to toggle)
$(bold)Grade 3$(): 5x5x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Grade 4$(): 5x5x5 cubic OR 5x5x1 flat (right-click to toggle)

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Left-click$(): Area mine (when not sneaking)
$(bold)Shift + Left-click$(): Single block mining
$(bold)Right-click$(): Toggle between cubic and flat mode (Grades 2 & 4 only)

pages.title: Materials
pages.text:
All tools match the durability, mining speed, and enchantability of their vanilla counterparts:
Stone: 655 durability
Iron: 1250 durability
Diamond: 7805 durability

The Kennestroyer Pickaxe is the ultimate mining tool, crafted from Netherite, Diamond Blocks, Obsidian, and the finest Diamond Workhand Improved Pickaxes. It combines all mining modes into a single tool with Vein Mining built-in.

pages.title: Mode Progression (Right-click to cycle)
pages.text:
$(bold)Disabled$(): No area mining
$(bold)Range 3 Flat$(): 3x3x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Range 3 Cubic$(): 3x3x3 cubic area
$(bold)Range 5 Flat$(): 5x5x1 area (single layer)
$(bold)Range 5 Cubic$(): 5x5x5 cubic area

pages.title: Vein Mining
pages.text: When breaking an ore block, all connected blocks of the same ore type are automatically mined in a chain reaction, up to a maximum of 128 blocks. Works regardless of sneak state.

pages.title: Controls
pages.text:
$(bold)Left-click$(): Area mine + vein mining (when not sneaking)
$(bold)Shift + Left-click$(): Single block mining
$(bold)Right-click$(): Cycle through 5 modes

pages.title: Stats
pages.text:
Durability: 50,000
Mining Speed: 12.0
Attack Damage: +4
Enchantability: 15
Repair: Netherite Ingots
